name: Nekojima

categories.label: Knocked the structure down
categories.hint: The player who makes the pole structure fall (or leaves a cable hanging) loses

categories.label: Won
categories.hint: Competitive mode: last player standing wins

winCondition: Competitive dexterity game: players take turns placing or stacking electrical poles; the player who brings the structure down loses and the last one standing wins.

endCondition.description: Structure collapses or a player is eliminated

notes: family: dexterity-elimination. Official rulebook (BGG file 'Nekojima Rulebook (US).pdf') could not be downloaded, so elimination details, how players are eliminated, and cat/bird's-nest token effects are unverified. Cooperative mode is in nekojima-2023--coop.json.
